trust_decision.summary: Before co-signing as fee payer, the server decides that the sender-signed transaction is canonical: no non-empty accessList, no nonzero call value, no call without calldata, and no extra bytes on sponsored-selector calldata. The decision lives in assertCanonicalSponsoredTransaction, called from assertTransactionPolicy in src/tempo/internal/fee-payer.ts, so the local sponsor (prepareSponsoredTransaction) and the hosted relay (fillHostedFeePayerTransaction) share one decision point.

landing_point.why: Every sponsored path funnels through this sponsor-policy validator; 'gas draining with padding' reads as a missing gas-policy input, and the neighbouring validateCalls (:323) only checks selectors and decoded arguments, never calldata length.

fix_sites.entry_point: tempo.charge `transaction` credential with fee sponsorship (src/tempo/server/Charge.ts:334), sponsored at :418 for a local feePayerAccount and at :442 for feePayerUrl

called from assertTransactionPolicy (src/tempo/internal/fee-payer.ts:449), which prepareSponsoredTransaction (:607) and fillHostedFeePayerTransaction (:193) both invoke; also reached from tempo.session open/topUp and legacy tempo.session

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The precompile settlement path builds its own calldata server-side (sendPrecompileTransaction, src/tempo/session/precompile/Chain.ts:934-971) and the session open/topUp calls are escrow management rather than payments, so a solver can argue both are outside the advisory's padding-on-a-transfer example.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Multi-call sponsored payments are legitimate: split charges batch up to 11 transfers (transferLimit) and swap payments prepend approve + swapExactAmountOut, so a fix that requires one canonical call or canonicalises only the first call rejects valid challenges.

O6_input_shapes: trailing bytes appended to a call's data for a sponsored selector (transfer, transferWithMemo, approve, swapExactAmountOut)
calldata for a sponsored selector that fails to decode
